title: BUGFIX — static mock brief insight-mock-005 fails why_does_this_matter specificity QC check
rationale: QC gate checkWhyDoesThisMatter requires text to contain a number, proper noun pattern, or consequence keyword (cost|billion|million|delay|risk|threat|impact|cause|lead to|result in). The 5th static mock brief's why field: 'Developers can now run production-quality AI without paying per token. This shifts power from cloud providers to hardware makers and open-source communities.' — contains none of these. This causes 1 out of 5 static mock briefs (insight-mock-005) to fail QC every run. Fix: rewrite the why field to include specificity indicators.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-insight/index.ts: update insight-mock-005 why field to include numbers and consequence words to pass QC specificity check.
